movie.title: Soulcatcher
movie.overview: During a total solar eclipse, four girls visit a mysterious witch's house looking for a magical ritual. But something goes wrong and they find themselves trapped in a dimensional limbo where the Soulcatcher rules... And only one can get out of there alive.

aiEnrichment.summary_one_sentence: When a magical ritual during a total solar eclipse goes terribly wrong, four young girls become trapped in a terrifying dimensional limbo ruled by the sinister Soulcatcher.
aiEnrichment.summary_short: Seeking a mystical ritual during a rare total solar eclipse, four friends venture into the secluded home of a mysterious witch. Their curiosity turns to horror when the spell malfunctions, severing their connection to reality and pulling them into a dark, otherworldly domain. Trapped in a dimensional limbo governed by an entity known as the Soulcatcher, they quickly realize the deadly stakes. To survive, they must confront the entity's twisted games, knowing that only one of them will ever return to the living world.
aiEnrichment.summary_long: Drawn by rumors of ancient magic, four young women gather during a total solar eclipse to perform a mysterious ritual at the home of a secluded witch. Hoping to unlock mystical secrets, they begin the incantation just as the moon completely obscures the sun. However, an uninvited error in the ritual disrupts the cosmic balance, tearing open a rift in the fabric of space and time. Instead of gaining power, the group is violently pulled through the tear into a bleak, shifting void known as the dimensional limbo. This horrific realm is absolute territory for the Soulcatcher, a cruel, ancient entity that feeds on human spirit and desperation. As the girls navigate the shifting, nightmare logic of the limbo, the Soulcatcher forces them to face their deepest fears and betray one another. Loyalty unravels as the grim rules of the dimension become terrifyingly clear to the group. With time running out and their sanity slipping away, they face the ultimate horror of their predicament. In the end, the dark dimension demands a tragic final sacrifice: only a single survivor can escape back to reality.
aiEnrichment.synopsis: During the rare alignment of a total solar eclipse, four adventurous friends seek out a rumored witch's home to perform an ancient magical ritual. What begins as a quest for mystical power rapidly devolves into a nightmare when the incantation tears open a rift between worlds. Transported into an eerie, treacherous dimensional limbo, the girls find themselves at the mercy of the Soulcatcher—a sinister entity that dominates the dark realm. As the environment twists their perceptions and tests their bonds, the group must navigate chilling perils and psychological horrors. Suspenseful and atmospheric, this dark thriller explores the ultimate test of friendship and survival against an inescapable otherworldly force.

story_structure.climax: Tensions reach a boiling point as the survivors face the final, deadly challenge against both the Soulcatcher and the tragic rule of escape.
story_structure.conflict: The ritual goes wrong, trapping the girls in a treacherous dimensional limbo ruled by an entity known as the Soulcatcher.
story_structure.resolution: A single survivor emerges back into the real world, permanently altered by the horrific ordeal and the sacrifices made.

story_structure.risingAction: As the girls navigate the perilous limbo and face increasing danger, they come to a chilling realization: only one of them can escape alive.

faq.answer: During a total solar eclipse, four girls visit a mysterious witch's house seeking a magical ritual. However, the ritual goes wrong, trapping them in a dark dimensional limbo where they must fight to survive.
faq.question: What is the main premise of Soulcatcher?

faq.answer: The dominant genre of Soulcatcher is supernatural horror, combined with elements of dark fantasy and survival thriller.
faq.question: What is the dominant genre of the movie?

faq.answer: No, Soulcatcher is a standalone supernatural horror film and is not part of an existing movie franchise or shared cinematic universe.
faq.question: Is this movie part of a franchise?

faq.question: Is there a post-credit scene?

faq.answer: The conflict begins when a magical ritual performed inside a mysterious witch's house during a total solar eclipse goes terribly wrong.
faq.question: What triggers the main conflict in the story?

faq.answer: After the ritual goes wrong, the setting shifts from the witch's house to an ominous, otherworldly dimensional limbo ruled by the entity known as the Soulcatcher.
faq.question: Where does the story take place after the ritual fails?

faq.answer: The primary antagonist is the Soulcatcher, a powerful entity that controls the dimensional limbo and forces the trapped girls into a deadly fight for survival.
faq.question: Who is the primary antagonist in the movie?

faq.answer: The stakes are strictly life and death: only one of the four girls can escape the dimensional limbo alive, forcing them into a desperate struggle for survival.
faq.question: What are the stakes for the four main characters?

faq.answer: No, the fundamental rule of the realm dictates that only one person can make it out alive.
faq.question: Can more than one girl escape the dimensional limbo?

faq.answer: Soulcatcher is primarily intended for fans of supernatural horror and dark thrillers due to its heavy focus on occult rituals, ominous dimensions, and intense survival themes.
faq.question: Is Soulcatcher suitable for non-horror fans?
